  APPLICATION OF SOUTHWESTERN ELECTRIC POWER
  COMPANY FOR AUTHORITY TO AMEND TARIFFS FOR
RETAIL ELECTRIC SERVICE TO INCLUDE NEW STANDARD
FORM CONTRACT FOR ELECTRIC SERVICE – LARGE LOAD




                       SOAH ORDER NO. 2
              MEMORIALIZING PREHEARING CONFERENCE

      On January 29, 2026, the Administrative Law Judge (ALJ) convened a
prehearing conference in this proceeding. The following parties appeared through
their representatives: Southwestern Electric Power Company (SWEPCO), Texas
Industrial Energy Consumers, Cities Advocating Reasonable Deregulation, the
Office of Public Utility Counsel, and staff of the Public Utility Commission of
Texas.


      SWEPCO represented the parties have been negotiating a proposed
procedural schedule and are close to finalizing one. Thus, the ALJ ORDERS
 parties to file a joint proposed procedural schedule by February 6, 2026.
Additionally, the parties SHALL file a statement whether mediation is appropriate
for this proceeding.



Signed January 29, 2026


                                            _____________________________
                                            Rachelle Nicolette Robles,
                                            Administrative Law Judge
